tools.name: account
tools.description: Your legit2compute account: credit balance, the media pipelines your key can run with their estimated cost, and per-model token prices. Call this first to see what is available.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Every language model your key can call, with context length, tool support, modality (text or vision) and price. "l2c/auto" picks the cheapest model that fits each request.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a prompt (or a full OpenAI-style messages array) to a hosted language model and get the answer. Billed per token from your credit. Use model "l2c/auto" unless you need a specific one from list_models.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Start a media job: images, image edits, music and songs, cloned voice and narration (in other languages too), sound effects, video from text or an image, long video to short clips, transcripts, articles, podcasts. Returns a job_id at once; then call get_job. Billed from your credit when it runs. Pip

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status of a media job. When it is completed, the result files with download links. wait_seconds (up to 50) keeps checking until the job ends or the time is up. Never submit a job again because it is still running: it is still billed.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "generate" is 1098 chars, far longer than this server's median (205). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Start a media job: images, image edits, music and songs, cloned voice and narration (in other languages too), sound effects, video from text or an image, long v…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chat · Private data: account, chat, get_job · Public sink: chat, get_job · Destructive: account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chat · Private data: account, chat, get_job · Public sink: chat, get_job · Destructive: account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
